description.value: South Bonson Community Centre is a City of Pitt Meadows municipal recreation facility in the South Bonson neighbourhood, offering drop-in fitness classes, gymnasium and sport programs, and programming for early years, seniors, and youth. Operated by the City, it is a public facility situated along Barnston View Road in a predominantly residential area of Pitt Meadows. It could serve as a rest point for touring cyclists passing through the area, though specific cyclist-facing amenities are unconfirmed.
